message.content: The cover of TEMPO magazine for November 4-10, 2024, features a large, profile illustration of a person in black and yellow robes against a light blue background. This figure wears a black songkok hat and holds a red wooden gavel in a black-gloved right hand. Overlapping the person's back is a red metal staircase structure. A smaller figure in a black suit stands on the topmost landing of the stairs, holding a hand to their face. Red block letters spell "TEMPO" at the top. Below, white and black text reads: "AKAL BULUS MAKELAR KASUS" and "Zarof Ricar menimbun uang yang ditengarai hasil suap pengaturan perkara di Mahkamah Agung hampir Rp 1 triliun. Membangun jaringan di semua level hakim. H. 72". Smaller text at the top reads: "Koalisi Rapuh Penyokong Ridwan Kamil-Suswono H. 30" and "Akrobat Menyelamatkan Sritex H. 86". A white box in the bottom right corner contains "4-10 NOVEMBER 2024", "RP 50.000", publishing information, a barcode, and a QR code.
